info.description:
REST API for the credit-report Android app: email/password auth with OTP verification, JWT sessions, profile management, and credit-report CRUD.

All routes are mounted under `/api`. Protected routes require an `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` header obtained from login or email verification.
info.title: Credit Report Service API

get.description: Returns all agents with status ACTIVE.

post.description: Creates a new agent with a unique referral code.

put.description: Allows an admin to set or update the agent code for any account by ID. Admins bypass the one-time update limit.
put.summary: Update agent code for any account (admin only)

get.description: Returns an agent's details along with the number of signups under that agent for a given date range. Query params: from, to (YYYY-MM-DD, optional).
get.summary: Get agent with signup count (admin only)

put.description: Updates an agent's name, email, and/or phone.

patch.description: Sets an agent's status to ACTIVE or INACTIVE.
patch.summary: Activate or deactivate an agent (admin only)

post.description: Marks the named account's KYC row as PAN-verified. Required before that account can request credit analytics. The caller must be an admin.

parameters.description: Account id whose PAN is being verified
parameters.name: accountId

404.description: No PAN on file for this account

post.description: Verifies a Google ID token (issued by the Android/iOS Google Sign-In SDK) and returns a session JWT. On first login, creates a verified account; on subsequent logins, reuses the existing account. If the Google email matches an existing account, the Google identity is linked onto it. Requires the Web OAuth client ID to be configured (AUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID); otherwise returns 503.

409.description: Google identity already linked to another account

post.description: Verifies email + password and returns a session JWT. Requires the email to be verified.

401.description: Invalid email or password / email not verified

post.description: Re-issues the signup OTP for an unverified email, subject to cooldown / send limits.

404.description: No signup found for this email

post.description: Creates a PENDING account with an unverified password identity and emails a verification OTP. Re-signing up for an unverified email updates the password and re-issues the OTP.
Checks the signup OTP; on success verifies the identity, activates the account, and returns a session JWT.

get.description: Returns derived analytics from the most recent successful credit report: on-time payment percentage, card utilization percentage, and enquiry count for the past 180 days.
get.summary: Get credit insights from the latest report

get.description: Returns a paginated list of the caller's reports, newest first. Each item carries only the report id (unique identifier) and generation date.
get.summary: List the authenticated account's credit-analytics reports

get.description: Returns the full report row (including the persisted upstream response body) for one of the caller's own reports.
get.summary: Fetch a credit-analytics report by id

404.description: Report not found (or belongs to another account)

post.description: Builds the Digitap /credit_analytics/request payload from the authenticated account's profile and KYC record (mobile, name, PAN), plus server-generated values (client_ref_num, otp, timestamp), then persists the request and full upstream response and returns the stored row. Only device_ip is taken from the request body; if omitted it falls back to the detected remote IP.
post.summary: Request a credit analysis from Digitap

parameters.description: Credit-analytics request (device_ip optional; defaults to the caller's IP)
parameters.name: request

400.description: Invalid request body / missing profile or PAN / upstream 400

post.description: Accepts a PAN (Permanent Account Number), validates the format, and upserts it against the account's KYC record. A re-submission overwrites any existing PAN and resets verification to PENDING.

409.description: PAN already linked to another account

get.description: Reports whether the service is up.
Returns the full account record for the current session.

put.description: Sets first/last name (required) and optional date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD), marking the profile step complete.
Sets or updates the agent code for the authenticated account. Non-admin users can only update once. Admins can update anytime.

409.description: Agent code can only be updated once
